title: console: the Packages sheet offers Edit, Publish, Revert, Disable, Duplicate and Delete app on a package badged "Read-only · code"
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-06** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. Paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → Apps → Packages → the HotCRM package's sheet.
- **Expected:** the sheet's own scope badge, "Read-only · code". A read-only package offers no write action. The platform refuses Publish and Revert on it with `422 [writable_package_required] … it is read-only (provided by code or an installed app)`.
- **Actual:** the sheet offers Edit, Publish, Revert, Disable, Duplicate and Delete app on the read-only package, so every write action it offers there is one the platform refuses. Evidence: [`02-apps-packages-hotcrm-detail.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-apps-packages-hotcrm-detail.png), [`02-apps-packages-action-publish.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-apps-packages-action-publish.png).
- **class:** a. **Reach:** every admin opening a code-provided or installed package.

## Seat review

- **Landing:** objectui's Packages sheet does not gate its actions on the package's scope.
- The server-side half of this finding (the update door's own read-only check) is objectstack#24705, closed 2026-10-20, after 18.0.0-next.5. This card is the console half only: offer no write action on a read-only package.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 10 hits in objectstack, 9 + 20 in objectui. objectstack#24705 is closed and covers the server only. No card covers the sheet's actions. **New.**
